name: hld
description: Turn a product or system idea into reviewed requirements and a vendor-neutral high-level design with Mermaid diagrams.

interface.longDescription: Run an interactive discovery interview, separate confirmed facts from assumptions and unknowns, and produce a decision-ready high-level design with a readable Mermaid architecture diagram.
defaultPrompt: Interview me and prepare requirements for my system idea.
Create an HLD from the approved requirements.md.
Review this architecture and identify material gaps.
